title: BACKPACK FULL IS ONE RED ROW
why: His order of 2026-10-09: a raid line is a short caps headline and, only when needed, a short detail. A full backpack said Backpack full with the raw capacity number in brackets and Z drops the selected item, in the middle of the screen, naming Z even with a controller in hand. It is now one red row in the pickup stack, BACKPACK FULL, refreshed while E is held and never a second row, with the button that drops the selected item as its detail: the bound key on a keyboard, Y on a controller. The stall says the same row when the backpack has no room.
now: A full backpack is one red BACKPACK FULL row naming the drop button of the device in hand.
